— Сохранение внедорожных качеств базовог: — Preservation of off-road qualities of the base chassis, including dimensions and weighting.
— Надёжность и прочность конструкции при: — Reliability and strength of the structure when operating in difficult conditions.
— Ремонтопригодность и неприхотливость,: — Maintainability and unpretentiousness, absence of rare imported components.
— Простой демонтаж и хранение жилого отс: — Easy dismantling and storage of the living compartment for using the chassis for other purposes.
— Избежать изменений в конструкции базов: — Avoid changes in the design of the basic vehicle and difficulties in registration.
— Эксплуатация по большей части в летнее: — Operation for the most part in summer.
— Модульная конструкция, возможность доб: — Modular design, the ability to add new components after purchasing the basic configuration.
В итоге Барибал представляет собой анало: As a result, Baribal is an analogue of a teardrop trailer mounted on the side platform of a half-trailer truck. The UAZ Profi 4x4 with a two-row cabin is chosen as the main chassis. However, it is possible to manufacture under other chassis with an on-board platform. The principle of using Baribal on a trip is described by a simple formula: "On the road, everyone rides in the cabin, in the parking lot, all life is spent on the street, the living compartment is for sleeping and relaxing."
